about: RFC 6.4.6 and 6.4.7: waivers, WaiverSHA and signed approvals. The V-waiversha vectors come from the frozen Go output.

vectors.title: A waived target with a valid approval is valid
A waived target with no approvals.json is refused
An approval for another target does not cover this one
A waiver edited after it was signed is refused
A file edited after the approval was signed is refused
A principal that the allowed signers do not list is refused
A signature made in another namespace is refused
A signature over the text without its final newline is refused
With no allowed signers nothing is approved
A signature by a key the allowed signers do not hold is refused
One valid approval is enough when another entry for the target is not
An allowed-signers line limited to another namespace does not allow this one
An allowed-signers line that lists the namespace allows it
With two waivers for one target the last one is the waiver
An approval of the first of two waivers for one target is refused
An approval with no waiver in the commit is refused
The approval binds the file of the target, in whatever directory it is
